## Publications

{% assign years = site.data.publications | map: "year" | uniq | sort | reverse -%}
{%- for y in years -%}
{%- assign in_year = site.data.publications | where_exp: "p", "p.year == y" -%}
{%- for pub in in_year -%}
{%- capture authors %}{% include list-names.html names=pub.authors %}{% if pub.type == "edited_volume" %} {{ I.eds_suffix[L] }}{% endif %}{% endcapture -%}
{%- assign title = pub.title | strip_html | strip -%}
{%- capture venue_line -%}
{%- case pub.type -%}
{%- when "article", "profile" -%}{{ pub.venue | strip_html }}{% if pub.volume %}, {{ pub.volume }}{% if pub.issue %}({{ pub.issue }}){% endif %}{% if pub.pages %}, {{ pub.pages }}{% endif %}{% else %}, {{ I.online_first[L] }}{% endif %}.
{%- when "chapter", "encyclopedia_entry" -%}In {{ pub.book_title | strip_html }}, {{ pub.publisher }}{% if pub.pages %}, pp. {{ pub.pages }}{% endif %}.
{%- else -%}{{ pub.venue | strip_html }}.
{%- endcase -%}
{%- endcapture -%}
{%- if pub.doi %}{% assign link = "https://doi.org/" | append: pub.doi %}{% elsif pub.url != "" %}{% assign link = pub.url %}{% else %}{% assign link = "" %}{% endif -%}
{%- assign last_char = title | slice: -1, 1 -%}
- {{ authors | strip }} ({{ pub.year }}). {{ title }}{% unless last_char == "?" or last_char == "." or last_char == "!" %}.{% endunless %} {{ venue_line | strip }}{% if link != "" %} {{ link }}{% endif %}
{% endfor -%}
{%- endfor %}
